title: Psychometric Personality Shaping Modulates Capabilities and Safety in Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks used measure general capabilities (MMLU), hazardous knowledge (WMDP), truthfulness (TruthfulQA), morality concepts (ETHICS), and sycophancy.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
